title: Citizens' groups announce protest march to CBI office in Kolkata

tea.why: Protesters are demonstrating over the slow progress of the investigation and the bail granted to the former hospital principal.
tea.want: They are demanding accountability from the CBI and action based on the evidence in the RG Kar Medical College and Hospital case.
tea.changed: Oct 24: Citizens groups 'Voice of Abhaya' and 'Voice of Women' announced a protest march to the CBI office for November 12.

summary: Citizens' groups in Kolkata have announced a protest march to the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) office scheduled for November 12. Organised by 'Voice of Abhaya' and 'Voice of Women', the demonstration will start from RG Kar Medical College and Hospital. The announcement follows criticism of the investigating agency's pace and the granting of bail to the former principal of the hospital in a corruption case. Organisers have called on citizens and particularly women to join the streets to demand accountability and press the CBI to act on evidence despite alleged attempts to suppress it. The victim's parents have also voiced strong criticism regarding the handling of the case and the delay in arresting individuals present before the death.
demands: Demand accountability from the CBI in the investigation
Urge the investigating agency to act on available evidence
Press for action against those responsible for destroying evidence
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: Citizens' groups Voice of Abhaya and Voice of Women announced a protest march to the CBI office for November 12.
